title: This Human Life Is a Chance
subtitle: So Purakh
summary: This shabad is a wake-up call. Human life is not framed as prestige but as opportunity for union, sangat, and Naam.
whyItMatters: It gives strong direction when life feels aimless, unfocused, or swallowed by distraction.
takeaway: Use this life for meeting, not merely for managing.

lines.translation: This human body has been given to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)dh milan kee ieh teree bareeaa ||
lines.translation: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||

lines.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||
Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam birathaa jaat ra(n)g maiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have not practiced meditation, self-discipline, self-restraint or righteous living.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raiyaa ||
lines.translation: I have not served the Holy, or the Lord, my King.
Says Nanak, our actions are contemptible!
O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||

structure: Names human birth as opportunity, not entitlement.
Points immediately toward sangat and Naam as the path of use.
Ends in humility and surrender rather than self-improvement pride.
